sloka: तम् मेरु शिखर आकारम् दीप्ताम् इव शत ह्रदाम् ।गगनस्थम् महीस्थास् ते ददृशुर् वानर अधिपाः ॥६-१७-२॥।।
transliteration: tam meru śikhara ākāram dīptām iva śata hradām ।gaganastham mahīsthās te dadṛśur vānara adhipāḥ ॥6-17-2॥।।

translations.english: All the Vanaras on the ground saw Vibheeshana who was like Mount Meru in form and shining like a brilliant lightning.
